snapshot.text: Health is largely devolved to the provinces, with a federal ministry for national health services and coordination. Polio eradication remains the national priority; Pakistan is one of the last countries with wild poliovirus.

minister.name: Mustafa Kamal
minister.role: Federal Minister for National Health Services, Regulations and Coordination

priorities.title: Polio eradication
priorities.text: The prime minister ordered provinces to prepare a coordinated polio eradication plan, and the polio drive is to cover children up to age 15.

priorities.title: Barcodes on all medicines
priorities.text: Every medicine in Pakistan is to carry a barcode, to fight counterfeit drugs.
